engineSemantics: KeywordHelpers.parseKeywords uses metadata as candidate names and then requires printed-text matches.
Core boolean regexes require the keyword at start of text or after a newline; mentions in sentences do not match.
Card.ts parses leader deployBox and leader text separately; numeric value zero is present because the check is value != null.
Card.ts effective keyword queries include ongoing gain effects, blanking and replacement.
minimumMissingEvidence: Synthetic parser/import tests for all five raw inputs: exact intrinsic sets above, no-keyword control and true Ambush control; also leader sides and Raid/Restore zero for general parser acceptance.

Real-engine differential Refugee positive Shield delivery to a genuine Sentinel and negative self eligibility when Refugee has no external Sentinel grant; cover optional skip/no valid target and compare complete legal actions.

Real-engine differential Shuttle with friendly ground units: true Sentinel gets +0/+2, ordinary mentioned-keyword Refugee gets no bonus, enemy and space controls get no bonus. Observe actual HP, not admission.

Combined Guards/Shuttle interaction: undamaged Guards gains Sentinel and +0/+2; damage removes both. Include a damage level that survives boosted HP but defeats Guards after losing the bonus, plus a survivor healed back to zero damage that regains both.

Real-engine Ambush positive for 4-LOM and dynamic Ambush/+1/+1 for friendly Zuckuss; non-Zuckuss and enemy controls, and source removal verifies loss. Observe ready/attack legal actions and resulting state.
Fresh matching engine snapshot, catalog/pool and immutable fixture identities, with passing native and rebuilt Wasm comparisons and exact action labels; no receipts are supplied in this packet.
